subject.title: perf(state): cap the per-agent SQLite handle cache with LRU eviction

question: Should `listSessionEntries({ readOnly: true })` become the supported public plugin-SDK contract for non-registering fleet introspection, or should the capability remain behind a narrower internal/plugin-local seam?
rationale: The branch intentionally expands a public plugin SDK entrypoint; repository policy treats such surface changes as compatibility-sensitive and requires maintainer-visible direction beyond a mechanical correctness repair.

options.title: Approve a narrow public read-only mode
options.body: Keep the additive option, document its non-registering and missing-database semantics, and land only after the two P1 lifecycle and migration defects are fixed.

options.title: Keep the capability internal
options.body: Move fleet-introspection callers to a core/internal read-only helper and avoid expanding the public session-store API.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow public read-only mode
recommendation.body: Keep the additive option, document its non-registering and missing-database semantics, and land only after the two P1 lifecycle and migration defects are fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: The active branch combines the state lifecycle change with the plugin-SDK surface expansion.
